summary: Danaos Corporation filed a Form 6-K disclosing it is exploring a carve-out and sale of a minority stake in its dry bulk segment, with Danaos Bulk Inc. as holding company, and has mandated investment banking firms to advise on a potential equity placement and listing in the Norwegian market; the US equivalent is a spin-off/IPO carve-out. The unit holds 11 Capesize vessels on the water and four Newcastlemaxes under construction for 2028 delivery. No stake percentage, price, premium, or timetable was disclosed, and no board recommendation or named advisor was given; the company cautions no transaction is assured. Watch for listing venue, minority stake size, valuation versus NAV, and regulatory timing.
